content:
# Community Rule Column 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 1 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1:1** [...the book-of the ru]le of-the-community: to-seek God with-all the-heart and-with-all the-soul,
**1:2** to-do the-good and-the-upright before-Him as He-commanded by-the-hand-of Moses and-by-the-hand-of all His-servants the-prophets;
**1:3** and-to-love all that He-has-chosen and-to-hate all that He-has-rejected; to-keep-far from-all evil
**1:4** and-to-cling to-all deeds-of-goodness; and-to-do truth and-righteousness and-justice
**1:5** in-the-land, and-to-walk no-more in-the-stubbornness-of a-guilty heart and-eyes-of-fornication,
**1:6** doing all evil; and-to-bring all-who-volunteer to-do the-statutes-of God
**1:7** into-the-covenant-of grace, to-be-united in-the-counsel-of God and-to-walk before-Him in-perfection
**1:8** according-to all the-things-revealed for-their appointed-times; and-to-love all the-Sons-of-Light,
**1:9** each-man according-to his-lot in-the-counsel-of God; and-to-hate all the-Sons-of-Darkness,
**1:10** each-man according-to his-guilt in-the-vengeance-of God.
**1:11** And-all who-volunteer for-His-truth shall-bring all their-knowledge and-their-strength
**1:12** and-their-wealth into-the-community-of God, to-purify their-knowledge in-the-truth-of the-statutes-of God, and-to-regulate their-strength
**1:13** according-to the-perfection-of His-ways, and-all their-wealth according-to His-righteous counsel; not-to-transgress in-any-one
**1:14** of-all the-words-of God in-their-appointed-times; not-to-advance their-times nor-to-lag-behind
**1:15** any-of their-seasons; and-not-to-turn-aside from-His-true statutes, going-to-the-right or-to-the-left.
**1:16** And-all who-come into-the-order-of the-community shall-pass into-the-covenant before-God, to-do
**1:17** according-to all that He-has-commanded, and-not-to-turn-back from-following-Him because-of any dread or-terror
**1:18** or-trial during-the-dominion-of Belial. And-when-they-pass into-the-covenant, the-priests
**1:19** and-the-Levites shall-bless the-God-of salvations and-all the-works-of His-truth; and-all
**1:20** those-passing into-the-covenant shall-say after-them: "Amen, amen."
**1:21** And-the-priests shall-recount the-righteous-acts-of God in-His-mighty deeds,
**1:22** and-shall-declare all the-acts-of-gracious-faithfulness toward-Israel; and-the-Levites shall-recount
**1:23** the-iniquities-of the-sons-of-Israel and-all their-guilty transgressions and-their-sins during-the-dominion-of
**1:24** Belial. And-all those-passing into-the-covenant shall-confess after-them, saying: "We-have-acted-perversely,
**1:25** we-have-transgressed, we-have-sinned, we-have-acted-wickedly, we and-our-fathers before-us, in-our-walking
**1:26** against-the-statutes-of truth; and-righteous is God, and-true is-His-judgment against-us and-against-our-fathers."

---
*EMET notes: Line 1:1 begins with a lacuna at the top of the column; the reconstruction "[the book of the ru]le" follows standard restorations. The Hebrew "serekh ha-yachad" is rendered as "rule of-the-community." Compound construct chains are hyphenated throughout. "Berith chesed" (1:7) rendered "covenant-of grace." "Beliya'al" (1:18, 1:24) preserved as "Belial." The confessional formula in 1:24-25 preserves each Hebrew verb distinctly.*
